name: Install gdu (Linux)
description: An interactive disk usage browser — walk the tree instead of reading a list. Linux only: the fallback downloads the Linux release binary.
author: voltius

snippets.name: Install gdu (Linux)
snippets.description: Uses the distro package where there is one, otherwise the official release binary into ~/.local/bin.

steps.content:
# gdu is an interactive disk usage browser — the one to reach for when you want
# to walk the tree instead of reading a list.
# A prior run may have landed gdu in ~/.local/bin, which is not on PATH for a
# non-interactive shell (e.g. `ssh host sh -s < script`) — put it there so the
# already-installed check below actually finds it.
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"

if command -v gdu >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "gdu is already installed"
else
  # Only some distros package it; Debian/Ubuntu generally do not, so those fall
  # through to the release binary below.
  if   command -v apk    >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo apk add --no-cache gdu
  elif command -v pacman >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo pacman -S --noconfirm gdu
  elif command -v dnf    >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo dnf install -y gdu
  fi
fi

if ! command -v gdu >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64|amd64)  ARCH=amd64 ;;
    aarch64|arm64) ARCH=arm64 ;;
    *) ARCH="" ;;
  esac
  if [ -z "$ARCH" ]; then
    echo "unsupported architecture: $(uname -m) — no release binary to install"
  else
    mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"
    curl -fsSL "https://github.com/dundee/gdu/releases/latest/download/gdu_linux_${ARCH}.tgz" | tar xz -C /tmp
    mv "/tmp/gdu_linux_${ARCH}" "$HOME/.local/bin/gdu"
    chmod +x "$HOME/.local/bin/gdu"
    # The installer wrote to ~/.local/bin; this shell may not have it on PATH yet.
    export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
  fi
fi

if command -v gdu >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  gdu --version | head -1
fi
